Subject: Project Update: New Delivery Date of 14 April

The third-party integration required for your project has taken longer to certify than the vendor originally indicated, and as a result the timeline has shifted by two weeks. Certification is a gate we cannot bypass without putting the stability of the final delivery at risk, so we have adjusted the schedule rather than cut corners to hold the original date.

The new delivery date is 14 April. Our team is continuing work on every part of the project that does not depend on the certification, so this delay will not create any further downstream slippage once the integration clears. We will send a confirmation as soon as certification is complete, well ahead of that date.

Does 14 April still work well with your own plans on your end, or is there a specific milestone before then we should prioritize? We are treating this delivery as a shared goal and want to make sure the revised date lines up with what matters most for you.
